title: Text helpers
description:
Write four string functions:

```javascript
function titleCase(text) { }        // "the lord of the rings" -> "The Lord Of The Rings" (words separated by single spaces)
function truncate(text, max) { }    // at most max characters; if cut, the last character is "…"
function countChars(text) { }       // the number of characters, counting an emoji as one
function receiptLine(item, price) { }   // item padded to 12 characters, price with 2 decimals right-aligned in 8
```

`truncate("Hello, world", 6)` is `"Hello…"`; text that fits is returned unchanged. `receiptLine("tea", 2.5)` is `"tea             2.50"`.
hints: `[...text]` splits a string into characters properly, keeping an emoji's two halves together.
`padEnd(12)` adds spaces on the right up to 12 characters (and does nothing if the text is longer); `toFixed(2)` gives two decimals as a string.
